items.summary:
Summary 
 The keepalive timeout was not used during the initial portion of a request. 
 Impact 
 An attacker could keep an idle connection open indefinitely before sending any data. 
 Workaround 
 Use a reverse proxy (as recommended for all production deployments) with sensible keepalive limits.

items.summary:
Impact 
 Due to a URL parsing issue, Requests releases prior to 2.32.4 may leak .netrc credentials to third parties for specific maliciously-crafted URLs.

items.title: [GHSA-4xw9-cx39-r355] json-web-token library is vulnerable to a JWT algorithm confusion attack
items.summary:
Summary 
 The json-web-token library is vulnerable to a JWT algorithm confusion attack. 
 Details 
 On line 86 of the 'index.js' file, the algorithm to use for verifying the signature of the JWT token is taken from the JWT token, which at that point is still unverified and thus shouldn't be trusted.
